title: Colt M4 carbine (R0977)

basis.modes: Documented: the M4's S-1-3 trigger group (safe, semi-automatic, 3-round burst) per MIL-C-70599A and the NSN listing for Colt R0977AU; the M4A1 replaced it with S-1-F. SAFE is not modelled; no gun in the game models a safety.
basis.cyclicRpm: Estimate inside the documented range: 700-970 rounds a minute cyclic (Wikipedia M4 carbine infobox); 700-900 for the M4 (GlobalSecurity, search snippet).
basis.burstCam: Documented: the M16A2/M4 burst cam does not reset when the trigger is released mid-burst, so the next pull fires only the remaining one or two rounds (US Army armorer course M16A2 supplement; patent US5623114 background). Owner decision 27 Oct: keep the real cam and show the count.
basis.owner: 27 Oct 2026, question tool: semi plus 3-round burst, real non-resetting cam.

scope: Prototype game tuning and visual animation timing, not calibrated firearm behaviour. Capacity counts the magazine only (no chambered round); a reload tops up from the reserve. The selector lever and bolt carrier are not articulated; the HUD shows the mode and the burst count.
